title: NFRA_OPLGTW OG-ap-20: ROLLBACK of an UNAUTHORIZED apply -- gateway-global-etfs-read-policy was applied during Phase A, which forbids any apply, with no ledger and no signed halves. 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~Z's own error.
author: 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~Z

legs.target: the unauthorized state is MEASURED before it is touched: gateway-global-etfs-read-policy live on gateway-global-internal-reader-role, and the role's other three policies read at their pre-act statement counts
legs.proof_required: get-role-policy on all four, with the document of the unauthorized one captured

legs.target: the policy is DESTROYED through safe-apply, targeted, restoring the state the halves will sign from
legs.proof_required: safe-apply output showing 1 destroyed, 0 added, 0 changed

legs.target: the policy is GONE and the role's other three are untouched
legs.proof_required: get-role-policy returns NoSuchEntity for the destroyed name, and the other three read their pre-act statement counts and resource lists
